name: Confirmation Party Details 7
definition: Parties used for acting parties that apply either to the whole message or to individual sides.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier for an organisation that is allocated by an institution, eg, Dun & Bradstreet Identification.

ProcessingIdentification.name: Processing Identification
ProcessingIdentification.definition: Unambiguous identification of the transaction for the party identified.

AdditionalInformation.name: Additional Information
AdditionalInformation.definition: Provides additional information to a party identification.

InvestorCapacity.name: Investor Capacity
InvestorCapacity.definition: Capacity of customer placing the order. Primarily used by futures exchanges to indicate the CTI code (customer type indicator) as required by the US CFTC (Commodity Futures Trading Commission).

TradingPartyCapacity.name: Trading Party Capacity
TradingPartyCapacity.definition: Capacity of customer placing the order. Primarily used by futures exchanges to indicate the CTI code (customer type indicator) as required by the US CFTC (Commodity Futures Trading Commission).
